rows.mutation: long-press opens the menu and also opens the chat

rows.counterexample: long-press, pick Open -> a message is sent

rows.mutation: dismissing the menu runs the feedback handler

rows.mutation: Chats menu offers feedback while feedback is off

rows.mutation: feedback pick does nothing (vacuous)

rows.mutation: pre-#457 selfMachines without AgentsView's install id
rows.counterexample: AgentsView stamps local sessions with its install id -> listed as 'Other machine', view only

rows.mutation: chatable ignores the host (other machines' chats sendable)
rows.counterexample: a Grok chat from another machine is marked chatable on this host

rows.mutation: routed ignores DASH_REMOTE_HOSTS (any machine's Claude Code or Codex chat is sendable)
rows.counterexample: a Codex chat from a machine this bridge has no route to is marked chatable; the send is then refused

rows.mutation: routed ignores the harness (any chat on a routable machine is sendable)
rows.counterexample: a Grok chat recorded on a routable machine is marked chatable, but only Claude Code and Codex resume over ACP there

rows.mutation: pre-#457 bridge refuses av: profiles
rows.counterexample: open a chatable Claude Code chat, send -> bridge: 'Profile routing unavailable on this bridge.'

rows.mutation: av: profile admitted for any session
rows.counterexample: profileId av:claude:9 with sessionId 8 -> admitted, the turn resumes the wrong session

rows.mutation: av: profile admitted for any harness
rows.counterexample: profileId av:claude:9 sent with harness codex -> admitted

rows.mutation: av: profile admitted without a session id
rows.counterexample: profileId av:claude:9 with no sessionId -> admitted as a new chat

rows.mutation: pre-#457 rejectTurn without the turn.rejected log line
rows.counterexample: phone sends to a host id that is not this bridge -> refused, nothing in the bridge log

rows.mutation: rejectTurn sends error but no done
rows.counterexample: refused turn -> the phone gets an error but no done: the turn spins forever

rows.mutation: unknown harness: bare return
rows.counterexample: chat for a harness this bridge does not know -> no log, no answer

rows.mutation: remote host: bare return
rows.counterexample: chat for another host -> no log, no answer

rows.mutation: routing refusal dressed up as a duplicate
rows.counterexample: a profile the bridge refuses is dropped as if it were a resend

rows.mutation: duplicate id starts a second turn
rows.counterexample: the phone resends a live turn id -> a second agent process starts

rows.mutation: chat skips the cwd check
rows.counterexample: chat with a cwd that is not a directory -> the agent starts anyway

rows.mutation: voice skips the speech check
rows.counterexample: voice turn with no speech-to-text set up -> starts anyway

rows.mutation: chat never starts (vacuous)
rows.counterexample: a valid new chat turn -> refused

rows.mutation: remote chat refused by remoteTurnProblem: bare return
rows.counterexample: continue a chat on another computer with no usable working directory -> no log, no answer

rows.mutation: remote chat with an unknown harness: bare return
rows.counterexample: remote chat for a harness this bridge does not know -> no log, no answer

rows.mutation: remote chat skips remoteTurnProblem
rows.counterexample: a chat whose profile, session id, cwd or attachments fail the remote checks -> starts an SSH-carried turn anyway

rows.mutation: remote chat with an unknown harness starts
rows.counterexample: remote chat for a harness this bridge does not know -> a Turn is created for it

rows.mutation: duplicate id starts a second remote turn
rows.counterexample: the phone resends a live remote turn id -> a second SSH-carried agent starts

rows.mutation: remote chat never starts (vacuous)
rows.counterexample: a valid chat on another computer -> refused
